name: Edit your own profile
description: The one field a competitor may change. The handle is not among them -- it is GitHub's, it is the profile's URL, and it is re-read on every sign-in. Empty or blank clears it back to null rather than storing a name made of spaces, and the profile then falls back to the handle. The UPDATE joins live_sessions so a revoked session cannot write, and the row is read back so the response is what was stored rather than what was sent.

body.detail: A display name is at most 60 characters. It is what people see beside your handle, not a biography.

input.query: UPDATE users u SET display_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(($3)::text, '')), '') FROM live_sessions ls WHERE u.id = ($1)::uuid AND ls.sid = ($2)::uuid AND ls.user_id = u.id

SELECT ls.sid AS session_ok, json_build_object('id', u.id, 'handle', u.handle, 'display_name', u.display_name, 'role', u.role, 'created_at', u.created_at) AS body FROM live_sessions ls JOIN users u ON u.id = ls.user_id WHERE ls.sid = ($2)::uuid AND ls.user_id = ($1)::uuid
